result.title: NitroGen: Observations on the Action Dynamics, Visual Instruction Following, and Spatial Exploration
result.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures and 10 Tables in the main paper, several more in the Appendices
result.summary: NitroGen is an open vision-action foundation model for game control. It is trained by behavior cloning on online gameplay videos. In this paper, we study the frozen controller in Hollow Knight and Trackmania as examples along three dimensions: action adaptation, visual instruction following, and spatial exploration. Our results indicate that NitroGen can adapt its actions to local context, but it lacks the planning, recovery, and exploration needed for longer-horizon game control.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以在线游戏视频行为克隆训练的视觉-动作基础模型 NitroGen 为对象，冻结其控制器后在 Hollow Knight 与 Trackmania 上从动作适应、视觉指令跟随、空间探索三方面做诊断，发现它能适应当地上下文，但缺少长程控制所需的规划、恢复与探索能力。
AI.relevance_reason:
其「冻结控制器 + 视觉指令跟随」的探测思路，可供核查 VLM 推理是否真正使用视觉证据（而非旁路），而局部适应尚可、长程规划与探索失败的
结论也可能为 STOP 决策与动态计算预算问题提供参照线索，需读原文确认探测设计。
